summary: Pensionary benefits for scheme employees; applicability of Cane Development Department rules; government's 1997 policy decisions extending retiral benefits; parity with Vinod Kumar Goel judgment; service governed by statutory rules despite temporary status; delay and waiver arguments rejected; financial burden on scheme funds no bar; estoppel not applicable; pension entitlement upheld.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upheld; respondents entitled to pensionary benefits including pension, gratuity, and other retiral dues.
